chrome.description: Control the user's real, signed-in Chrome through the Pi Chrome Connector companion extension.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check the Chrome bridge: whether the companion extension is connected, whether Chrome control is authorized, and how to connect the extension if it is not. Start here before any other Chrome tool.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Unlock Chrome control so tools that change the page (navigate, click, type, fill, key, upload) can run. Call this only when the user asks for browser control.

duration.description: How long the authorization lasts: "indefinite", or a number of minutes (e.g. "15"). Defaults to "indefinite".

tools.name: revoke
tools.description: Lock Chrome control. Read-only tools keep working; tools that change the page are blocked until the next `authorize`.

tools.name: tab
tools.description: List, open, activate, close, or group tabs in the user's real Chrome. Use action=list to see what is open. New tabs join this session's tab group.

targetId.description: Chrome tab id. Unstable across reloads — prefer urlIncludes/titleIncludes when you can.

urlIncludes.description: Match the target tab by URL substring.

titleIncludes.description: Match the target tab by title substring.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Observe the page in the user's real Chrome: structure, visible actions, form fields, page text, and what changed since the previous snapshot. Returns stable uids you can pass to click/type/fill. Use query or mode to zoom in instead of dumping the whole page.

targetId.description: Chrome tab id. Unstable across reloads — prefer urlIncludes/titleIncludes when you can.

urlIncludes.description: Match the target tab by URL substring.

titleIncludes.description: Match the target tab by title substring.

background.description: If true (the default) run silently without focusing Chrome. Pass false to focus Chrome and activate the tab so the user can watch.

mode.description: Which view of the page to return.

query.description: Find and rank elements, regions, and text matching this phrase, e.g. "merge button", "email error", "approve PR".

maxTextChars.description: Max body text characters to include.

containingText.description: Only return elements whose label or text contains this string.

roleFilter.description: Only return elements matching this ARIA role or tag name, e.g. "button", "link".

nearUid.description: Sort elements by proximity to this snapshot uid.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find elements, page regions, or text on the page by natural-language query. Returns ranked matches with stable uids and coordinates. A focused form of snapshot({ query }).

query.description: What to find, e.g. "merge button", "search box".

targetId.description: Chrome tab id. Unstable across reloads — prefer urlIncludes/titleIncludes when you can.

urlIncludes.description: Match the target tab by URL substring.

titleIncludes.description: Match the target tab by title substring.

background.description: If true (the default) run silently without focusing Chrome. Pass false to focus Chrome and activate the tab so the user can watch.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Inspect one snapshot uid or selector deeply: nearby text, nearby actions, form context, ancestors, and a suggested click target. Use after snapshot/find when you need context around one element.

uid.description: Stable element uid from snapshot or find.

selector.description: CSS selector, if no uid is available.

scrollIntoView.description: Scroll the target into view before inspecting. Default false.

targetId.description: Chrome tab id. Unstable across reloads — prefer urlIncludes/titleIncludes when you can.

urlIncludes.description: Match the target tab by URL substring.

titleIncludes.description: Match the target tab by title substring.

background.description: If true (the default) run silently without focusing Chrome. Pass false to focus Chrome and activate the tab so the user can watch.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a Chrome tab to a URL. With no target, this session's dedicated automation tab is used — your currently active tab is never replaced. Pass targetId/urlIncludes/titleIncludes to act on a specific existing tab.

initScript.description: JavaScript to run in the page at document_start of the next navigation. Useful for seeding localStorage or stubbing Date.now().

targetId.description: Chrome tab id. Unstable across reloads — prefer urlIncludes/titleIncludes when you can.

urlIncludes.description: Match the target tab by URL substring.

titleIncludes.description: Match the target tab by title substring.

background.description: If true (the default) run silently without focusing Chrome. Pass false to focus Chrome and activate the tab so the user can watch.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the page (MAIN world, so it is not blocked by the page's CSP) and return a JSON-serializable value. Keep expressions read-only unless the user has authorized actuation.

targetId.description: Chrome tab id. Unstable across reloads — prefer urlIncludes/titleIncludes when you can.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by snapshot uid, CSS selector, or viewport coordinate using Chrome's real input layer. Prefer uid over selector after a snapshot.

uid.description: Stable element uid from snapshot or find.

x.description: Viewport x coordinate, if no uid or selector.

y.description: Viewport y coordinate, if no uid or selector.

includeSnapshot.description: Return a fresh snapshot after the click.

titleIncludes.description: Match the target tab by title substring.
